definition.title: Check that people who hear your name can find you
definition.description: Run after onboarding, a launch or a rename, and again after fixing: search your name the way someone who only heard it would, get a verdict on whether they reach your site, and at most three fixes for the searches that lose them. It never changes your site, posts or contacts anyone.

prerequisites.reason: The plan names the business and what it does, so brand_name and category can stay empty.
The audit's evidence holds the brand name and every host the site is served from, so pages on them count as found.

brand_name.title: Brand or product name
brand_name.description: Leave empty to use the name Tin already holds: the onboarding plan, the latest organic audit, or project memory.

domain.title: Site domain
domain.description: A bare host such as example.com. Leave empty to use the site from the latest organic audit, keyword plan or project memory.

category.title: What people would add to the name
category.description: Two to four words that say what it is, such as "invoice app". Leave empty to take it from the onboarding plan.

heard_as.title: How people say or misspell it
heard_as.description: Spellings you have seen people use after hearing the name. One per line.
